cases.transcript: AGENT: Can you clear the arrears? BORROWER: Yes, I'll pay 150 euros on the 5th by bank transfer.
AGENT: When can you pay? BORROWER: I'll try to sort something out next week, I think.
AGENT: We need the full amount. BORROWER: I can do 50 now on my card and the rest at the end of the month.
BORROWER: I'm not paying this, it's a mistake and I dispute it. AGENT: I understand.
AGENT: Shall we set up a direct debit? BORROWER: Fine, take 200 euros on the 15th by direct debit.
BORROWER: Look, I've got the money, I'll transfer the whole 480 tomorrow. AGENT: Thank you.
AGENT: Can you commit to a date? BORROWER: Honestly I have no idea when I can pay, things are really tight.
BORROWER: I'll bring 100 in cash to the office on Friday. AGENT: See you then.
AGENT: The balance is 320. BORROWER: I can manage 320 by the 20th, card is easiest.
BORROWER: My daughter's ill, I can't think about this now. Call me next month. AGENT: Of course.
AGENT: Any payment today? BORROWER: I'll pay something, maybe 60 or 70, when I get paid.
BORROWER: Set me up on a plan, 90 a month starting the 1st by direct debit. AGENT: Done.
AGENT: We could really use a payment. BORROWER: Yeah yeah, I hear you. We'll see. Bye.
BORROWER: I'll clear all 250 euros this Friday, transfer from my bank. AGENT: Appreciated.
AGENT: How about half now? BORROWER: OK I'll pay half, so 175, tomorrow on the card.
BORROWER: Stop calling me. I already told the last person I can't do anything.
AGENT: When suits you? BORROWER: Payday is the 25th, I'll send 300 that day.
BORROWER: I want to pay but I genuinely can't right now. Maybe once I find work. AGENT: I see.
AGENT: Direct debit on the 10th? BORROWER: Yes that works, 120 on the 10th, direct debit is fine.
BORROWER: I'll get back to you later once I've spoken to my wife. AGENT: Please do.
BORROWER: Take the full 600 off my card right now, let's just close it. AGENT: Processing.
AGENT: Can we agree something? BORROWER: I'll pay when I pay. Don't pin me to a date.
BORROWER: Bank transfer of 45 euros on the 8th, that's all I can manage. AGENT: Understood.
AGENT: Payment plan? BORROWER: No. I've decided I'm going through insolvency. Nothing's coming.
BORROWER: I'll drop 80 in cash on the 12th and another 80 the week after. AGENT: Noted.
